parsed.e_t: The agent is on the 'New Milestone' creation page for the Byte Blaze / dotfiles GitLab project. The Title field contains 'Merge all branches to main'. The Start Date textbox (id 5590) is currently focused and contains corrupted text '2990-09-064-03-302044-03-15', with a calendar picker showing September 2990 with day 6 selected. C: The date fields use a custom date picker widget that appends typed text to existing content rather than replacing it, causing corruption when typing YYYY-MM-DD format repeatedly
The Start Date must be set to March 15, 2044
The Due Date must be set to March 30, 2044
The milestone title must be 'Merge all branches to main'

F_t.cause: The date picker widget appends typed characters to existing field content rather than replacing it. Each type action adds '2044-03-15' to whatever was already in the field, resulting in progressively longer corrupted strings like '2044-07-3044-03-30', '2053-07-294-03-30', etc. The DOM consistently shows the field value growing with each type action.
Same issue as start date field - the due date picker appends typed text rather than replacing it, resulting in corrupted values like '0', '004', '0044', '004404', etc. growing with each type action.
Clicking the due date field did not focus it away from the start date field - the start date field remained focused per DOM observation at step 14.
Clicking the month combobox opened the dropdown but did not change the month - the combobox remained showing October selected per DOM at step 44.
Clicking March in the month dropdown did not update the start date field value - the field still showed '2156-10-30' per DOM at step 45, and the calendar still showed October 2156.

K_t: The milestone title 'Merge all branches to main' is correctly entered in the Title field
The date picker fields do not support direct text input via the 'type' action - text is appended rather than replacing existing content

The correct approach to set dates would be to first clear the field (using the 'Clear start date' / 'Clear due date' links), then use the calendar picker dropdowns to select the correct month (March) and year (2044), then click the day (15 for start, 30 for due)
The 'Clear start date' link has id 5591 and 'Clear due date' link has id 5595
The month combobox for the start date calendar is accessible and shows all 12 months as menu items
The year combobox for the start date calendar shows a range of years as menu items
The 'Create milestone' button (id 5603) is present and enabled on the form
The project is 'Byte Blaze / dotfiles' with project ID 193
The milestone form URL is under the project's Issues > Milestones > New path
